room_description: An elegant, luxurious bedroom featuring a large bed, patterned wallpaper, an armoire, a grandfather clock, a wooden chest resting on a bench, and a framed jigsaw puzzle on the wall.

key_moments.description: Collecting a puzzle piece from inside the ice bucket on the bed tray.
Collecting a second puzzle piece pinned to the black coat hanging on the mannequin.
Collecting a third puzzle piece from the top of the chest, revealing the red text '6:15'.
Completing the framed jigsaw puzzle on the wall.
The completed jigsaw puzzle morphs into a clue showing an arrangement of dots and lines.
Arranging the wooden sliders on the chest to match the dot pattern from the puzzle clue.
Retrieving two metal rings from inside the opened chest.
Placing the rings onto the two pegs of the grandfather clock face to open the glass cover.
Setting the hands on the clock face to '6:15', causing the bottom cabinet door to swing open.
Retrieving the main door key from the bottom of the grandfather clock.
Unlocking the exit door with the key.

solution_steps: Find the 3 missing puzzle pieces around the room (ice bucket, coat, chest).
Assemble the pieces to form a complete picture of a Venetian canal.
Observe the line and dot pattern revealed after finishing the jigsaw puzzle.
Interact with the front of the wooden chest.
Move the three wooden sliders so they align perfectly with the dot positions shown on the clue.
Attach the two rings to the small pegs on the grandfather clock face to act as handles.
Set the clock hands to read '6:15', using the clue written in red on top of the chest.

final_action: The player takes the key revealed in the bottom compartment of the grandfather clock and uses it to unlock the main door.
